motion.name: control-transition
motion.purpose: Primary hover and URL underline state changes.

motion.name: scan-pulse
motion.purpose: Active status dot; opacity reaches .3 at halfway; disabled for reduced motion.

motion.name: score-count
motion.purpose: Client count-in; skipped when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Scan Action
components.description: Primary URL submission, with its specific hover lift.
components.css: .ds-scan-action { min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; border:0; border-radius:0; color:var(--bg, #000); background:var(--accent, #ff2e7e); font:650 14px var(--display, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease, transform .2s ease; } .ds-scan-action:hover { background:var(--accent-strong, #e0186a); transform:translateY(-1px); } .ds-scan-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ff2e7e); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Report Primary Action
components.description: Unlock or copy action in the report.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display:block; min-height:50px; padding:0 20px; color:var(--bg, #000); background:var(--accent, #ff2e7e); border:0; border-radius:0; font:650 14px var(--display, sans-serif); cursor:pointer; transition:background .2s ease; } .ds-primary-action:hover { background:var(--accent-strong, #e0186a); } .ds-primary-action:disabled { opacity:.6; cursor:wait; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ff2e7e); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Underline URL Field
components.description: Open URL entry with a shared bottom rule that becomes pink on focus.
components.css: .ds-scan-field { border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink-soft, rgba(255,255,255,.78)); transition:border-color .2s ease; } .ds-scan-field:focus-within { border-color:var(--accent, #ff2e7e); } .ds-scan-field input { width:100%; height:64px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:transparent; outline:0; color:var(--ink, #fff); font-family:var(--display, sans-serif); font-size:clamp(18px, 2vw, 24px); letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-scan-field input::placeholder { color:var(--ink-faint, rgba(255,255,255,.56)); opacity:1; } @media(max-width:720px) { .ds-scan-field input { height:58px; font-size:17px; } }

components.name: Footer Navigation
components.description: Faint mono text links with generous interaction targets.
components.html: TermsPrivacyRefunds
components.css: .ds-footer-nav { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:22px; color:var(--ink-faint, rgba(255,255,255,.56)); font:11px var(--mono, monospace); } .ds-footer-nav a { min-width:44px; min-height:44px; display:inline-flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; } .ds-footer-nav a:hover { color:var(--ink, #fff); } .ds-footer-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ff2e7e); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Chrome Score
components.description: The signature metallic reading with denominator and restrained pink marker.
components.html: 88/100
components.css: .ds-score { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; position:relative; margin-bottom:32px; } .ds-score-number { font-family:var(--display, sans-serif); font-size:clamp(160px, 24vw, 292px); line-height:.73; font-weight:560; letter-spacing:-.04em; background:var(--chrome, linear-gradient(174deg, #fff 0%, #d4d4d4 20%, #fff 31%, #acacac 45%, #888 48%, #fff 50%, #f5f5f5 54%, #919191 57%, #c4c4c4 76%, #fff 94%)); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-score-denom { color:var(--ink-faint, rgba(255,255,255,.56)); font:16px var(--mono, monospace); margin:9px 0 0 12px; } .ds-score-tick { position:absolute; width:68px; height:4px; background:var(--accent, #ff2e7e); bottom:-22px; left:4px; box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,46,126,.35); } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-score-number { font-size:clamp(150px, 50vw, 220px); } }

components.name: Category Reading
components.description: Thin data bar, semantic label, and tabular reading.
components.css: .ds-category { display:grid; grid-template-columns:120px 1fr 42px; gap:15px; min-height:44px; align-items:center; color:var(--ink, #fff); font:14px var(--display, sans-serif); } .ds-category-track { height:2px; background:#272327; overflow:hidden; } .ds-category-track i { display:block; width:80%; height:100%; background:var(--accent, #ff2e7e); } .ds-category-score { text-align:right; font:12px var(--mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media(max-width:760px) { .ds-category { grid-template-columns:86px 1fr 36px; gap:10px; font-size:13px; } }

components.name: Selected Tool Tab
components.description: A plain-text selected tool; selection is pink and underlined.
components.css: .ds-tool-tabs { display:flex; gap:5px; flex-wrap:wrap; } .ds-tab { min-height:44px; padding:0 14px; color:var(--ink-soft, rgba(255,255,255,.78)); background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:0; cursor:pointer; font:17px/1.55 var(--display, sans-serif); } .ds-tab.ds-active { color:var(--accent, #ff2e7e); text-decoration:underline; text-underline-offset:8px; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ff2e7e); outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Prompt Output
components.description: Scrollable mono output on a flat near-black surface.
components.html:
Preserve the page’s brand.
Use the measured findings to prioritize changes.
components.css: .ds-prompt-output { max-height:520px; overflow:auto; white-space:pre-wrap; word-break:break-word; background:var(--surface, #0a0a0a); padding:clamp(20px, 4vw, 40px); color:var(--ink-soft, rgba(255,255,255,.78)); font:13px/1.65 var(--mono, monospace); } .ds-prompt-output:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #ff2e7e); outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.northStar: The Pinned Regular Basis Editorial World
narrative.overview:
A black editorial canvas gives the page its structure through scale, whitespace, and fine horizontal rules. Inter Display carries both headlines and prose; Geist Mono identifies measurements, provenance, release information, and tool output. Hot pink marks the action or reading that matters.

The score is the material signature: monochrome reflection bands clipped to large numerals, accompanied by a restrained pink marker. Supporting content remains flat and sparse. Rendered website captures retain their own source colors; those colors do not expand the RB004 interface palette.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome chrome scores with hot pink actions and readings.
Underline fields and flat rectangular controls.
Readable provenance, coverage, and unknown states.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Use hot pink for primary actions, selected tools, category bars, indices, and focused fields; keep the surrounding interface monochrome.

rules.name: The Measurement Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Geist Mono for data and provenance; use the Inter Display stack for headings and explanatory prose.

rules.name: The Chrome Score Rule
rules.body: Reserve metallic reflection gradients for score numerals. Keep ordinary surfaces flat; the small score marker and live status dot may glow.

dos: Do preserve black space, large left-aligned type, and horizontal section rules.
Do keep provenance and unavailable-check notes readable beside the results they qualify.
Do use the supplied Inter Display and Geist Mono files for exported score graphics.
Do preserve visible pink focus outlines, keyboard tabs, 44px control targets, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce additional interface hues or borrow the captured website’s palette.
Don't replace editorial rows with gray outlined card grids, inflated radii, or decorative icon tiles.
Don't flatten the chrome score to white or spread its reflection gradient into backgrounds.
Don't invent proof, measured values, or availability to fill a visual gap.
